build_enformer_model: build an Enformer model instance with configurable channels, transformer layers, and attention pooling type
run_enformer_prediction: run the Enformer model on a batch of one-hot encoded DNA sequences for gene expression prediction
create_one_hot_encoding: create a one-hot encoded numpy array from a DNA sequence string using the ACGT alphabet
build_softmax_pooling_layer: build a SoftmaxPooling1D layer with per-channel weighted pooling for sequence feature reduction
generate_exponential_filter_sizes: generate an exponentially increasing list of integer filter sizes divisible by a given number
